title: MDIA: A Benchmark for Multilingual Dialogue Generation in 46 Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the performance of dialogue generation models (mT5, DialoGPT) across 46 different languages using both automatic metrics (sacreBLEU, BERTScore, Distinct, Entropy) and human evaluations to measure the generation quality and disparity between high-resource (e.g., English) and low-resource languages.

Translating 100 English toxic phrases into other languages to construct a multilingual toxic vocabulary, applying it as a filter, and conducting human evaluation on the corpus to verify the effective removal of toxic and biased training data.
